title: WIBTA if I asked a girl out, that my best friend happens to be crushing on?
question: WIBTA if I asked a girl out, that my best friend happens to be crushing on?
body:
For context, me and my friend, (we'll call him Bill) are both 23. We lead pretty standard lives. Every weekend Bill and I get Qdoba, it's our favorite restaurant. And theres a girl who works there who is genuinely good looking. And Bill is really attracted to her. Problem is, Bill isnt the type of guy to ask a random girl out. But I most definitely am. So reddit, WIBTA if I asked her out? 

(On mobile sorry for formatting)
